# Settings > Searchable multi-page settings shell with responsive navigation and accessible control groups. This file matches the installed `settings-block` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/settings-block.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/settings-block.md`. ## npm dependencies - `lucide-react@^1.78.0` ## Registry dependencies - `button` - `core` - `empty` - `field` - `input` - `input-group` - `live-status` - `motion` - `scroll-area` - `sidebar` - `typography` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/blocks/settings-data`: `normalizeSettingsSearchText`, `searchSettings`, types `SettingsControlProps`, `SettingDefinition`, `SettingsSectionDefinition`, `SettingsPageDefinition`, `SettingsSearchResult` - `@/components/control-ui/blocks/settings`: `SettingsBlock`, `SettingsBackAction`, types `SettingDefinition`, `SettingsControlProps`, `SettingsPageDefinition`, `SettingsSectionDefinition`, `SettingsBlockProps` ## Composition ### Rendered settings shell ```tsx search page navigation back action active page content
``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { SettingsIcon, SparklesIcon } from "lucide-react"; import { useState } from "react"; import { SettingsBackAction, SettingsBlock, type SettingsPageDefinition }
